I'll be happy to answer any questions you may have about all this... It is important to understand that the Institute
is not a start up software company selling software. It's an Institute who is developing advanced technologies in
the modelling and simulation arena -of which the first is called ACES (Advanced Collaborative

Russell in a former company of his.
Anyway, so let me know what you think about this.. and whether you might like to come in on it.
If you do, however, you will need to make up your mind almost right away - as the offer closes tomorrow.
much love Christine
